question: What spatial measure and liberative quality are specified in this part of the invocation?
premises: An epithet indicates absence of rebirth
A measure of nine bow-lengths is named
Both are included in the address
inference: The invocation links a nine-bow-length area with a state free from rebirth.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of nava+dhanvantarāya as epithet or location is ambiguous.
plain_english: And to the one associated with non-rebirth, and to the area of nine bow-lengths.
